title: Independent Living Residency Agreement — Addendum on Notice Periods for Moves Within Larkspur
content:
## Clause 1 — The notice period by the move stated

The notice period added to the notice date of an Independent Living Residency Agreement follows the move the notice states:

(a) a notice stating a move to a Larkspur memory care residence adds 0 calendar days, because a move to memory care is made as soon as a secured suite is ready;

(b) a notice stating a move to a Larkspur assisted living residence adds the internal transfer notice period of the apartment type in calendar days;

(c) any other notice adds the move-out notice period of the apartment type in calendar days.

## Clause 2 — Fee end date on a move within Larkspur

For a notice stating a move to a Larkspur assisted living or memory care residence, and for an internal transfer to either recorded without notice, the fee end date is the later of the vacate date and the notice date plus the notice period that move carries.

## Schedule to Clause 1(b)

| Apartment type | Internal transfer notice period for a move to Larkspur assisted living |
|---|---|
| Independent Living Studio | 7 days |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom | 7 days |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom Deluxe | 7 days |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom | 7 days |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom Deluxe | 7 days |
| Independent Living Cottage Home | 14 days |

## Examples (hypothetical dates)

| Apartment type | Notice dated | Move stated | Notice date plus period | Vacate date | Fee end date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| One-Bedroom | June 20 | Larkspur assisted living | June 27 | July 3 | July 3 |
| Cottage Home | June 20 | Larkspur assisted living | July 4 | June 30 | July 4 |
| Two-Bedroom | June 20 | Larkspur memory care | June 20 | June 24 | June 24 |

The move a notice states is the one recorded on the residency with the notice.
